description: This file defines the BadResponseException class, which represents an exception for HTTP response errors (4xx and 5xx status codes) in the Guzzle HTTP client library. It extends RequestException and provides methods to check if a response exists and to retrieve it.

classes.name: BadResponseException
classes.description: Exception class for HTTP error responses (4xx or 5xx), extends RequestException, indicating an error with an associated response.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for BadResponseException, initializes the exception with message, request, response, optional previous exception, and handler context.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Indicates that this exception always has a response object associated with it.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the associated ResponseInterface object. Narrows the parent's method return type from nullable to non-nullable.
